reader.requirement: A REWRITE of a relative file (always mass storage) executed while the file is not open in the I-O mode (never opened, open INPUT or OUTPUT, closed, or after a failed OPEN I-O) must be unsuccessful with I-O status 49 (VIII.1.3.4 (5)h), leave the file unchanged, run neither the INVALID KEY nor the NOT INVALID KEY phrase (49 is a logic error, not an invalid key) and run any applicable USE procedure, in every access mode; open I-O it proceeds.

edition-consulted.switches: below 2002 a random/dynamic-access REWRITE with no INVALID KEY and no applicable USE is refused (VIII.4.6.3 SR4); compile time only, not the open-mode rule

reader.edition-search: runtime path: grep of DialectBehaviors.IsActive in src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Runtime/IO finds none on RelativeConnector.Rewrite or MutationOpenModeGuard (the one relative consult is WRITE's RelativeWriteKeyOutOfRangeIsPermanentError); SequentialIoBinder.BindRewrite's only edition use is ctx.Edition for refusal reports
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the 49 open-mode guard is one member for every edition; the run at --std 2023 prints the same lines
reader.witnesses-cover: part: l1_open_not_open_statements covers statements on a file not open; not exercised there for a relative REWRITE: open INPUT and OUTPUT, after CLOSE, after a failed OPEN I-O, the phrases not running on 49, and the USE procedure

reader.notes: RelativeConnector.Rewrite asks MutationOpenModeGuard first (after a permanent-error replay), which answers 49 unless the connector is open I-O, and MutationTargetRecordId identifies no record so the lock check cannot pre-empt it. With no USE procedure the program continues after the 4x status, which VIII.1.3.4 leaves to the implementor.

refuter.evidence: Probe r3ext.cob at --std 85 (runs/r3ext-001) aimed at the open mode the reader did not try: a sequential-access relative file opened EXTEND (1985 VIII.4.4.4 GR11 allows EXTEND for relative) gives 49 on REWRITE before and after a WRITE (E1, E2) through the USE, file unchanged (T reads QQQQ/BBBB/CCCC); open I-O with no prior READ gives 43 not 49 (GR2's arm, I1), then READ+REWRITE 00; an absent OPTIONAL file opened INPUT gives 49 with neither INVALID KEY nor NOT INVALID KEY run, USE runs. RelativeConnector.Rewrite calls MutationOpenModeGuard first; the only runtime edition consult nearby (FileConnector.SharingFacilityInEffect, DialectBehavior.FileSharingFacility) gates lock admission, not the 49. cites: OK  §1985:VIII.4.6.4 GR1  (4.6.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR1; OK  §1985:VIII.4.4.4 GR11  (4.4.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR11.
